criterion_text: After cache extraction, one cold authorized Range download and one warm cache hit exhibit the existing byte-transfer/verification semantics; interrupted downloads resume correctly, corrupted downloads are rejected, per-Agent namespaces remain isolated, concurrent callers do not publish conflicting partials, and pin-protected in-use images cannot be evicted. The test must exercise the real extracted cache API, not a reimplemented test-only downloader.

verifiers.summary: The extracted EROFS cache preserves cold/warm transfer, resume, verification, namespace isolation, concurrency and pin/eviction semantics through the real production adapter

evidence.value: exact SHA 73851ebdad033d6241245c1c70434c0b01b99cf2: the extracted cache API performed one cold authenticated fetch and a warm hit with zero body transfers; an interrupted partial resumed with one Range request; a mismatched or corrupted body was rejected and never published; two identities on one root never shared ready or partial files; concurrent callers shared one fetch; a pinned digest was not evicted

exact SHA 73851ebdad033d6241245c1c70434c0b01b99cf2: the Agent Managed preparation used the extracted cache through its thin adapter, reusing the warm cache for a second attempt while creating a distinct Agent-owned workspace
